{
  "schema": "trnm-pq-system-required-tests-v1",
  "scope": "explicit PNQ2/PqWitnessV4 component controls; no whole-system qualification",
  "expected_meaningful_controls": 47,
  "tests": [
    "ingress::pq_network::live_admission_tests::elapsed_deadline_refuses_before_charge_and_cached_replay_stays_live_only",
    "ingress::pq_network::live_admission_tests::deadline_cancels_signature_owner_wait_without_waiting_for_unlock",
    "ingress::pq_network::live_admission_tests::expiry_cancels_signature_owner_wait_and_preserves_unused_sequence",
    "ingress::pq_network::live_admission_tests::cancelled_intake_does_not_allocate_or_spend_connection_credit",
    "ingress::pq_network::live_admission_tests::failed_signature_keeps_charge_then_same_sequence_executes_real_pq_transfer",
    "pq_rollback_witness::tests::cancellation_after_signing_before_send_preserves_same_client",
    "pq_rollback_witness::tests::schema_rejects_extra_sqlite_objects_and_oversized_sql_text",
    "pq_rollback_witness::tests::same_keys_under_different_binding_generation_cannot_authorize_current",
    "pq_rollback_witness::tests::authenticated_matching_late_cas_is_known_success_and_client_stays_usable",
    "pq_rollback_witness::tests::slow_drip_read_obeys_one_absolute_deadline",
    "pq_rollback_witness::tests::slow_drip_write_obeys_one_absolute_deadline",
    "store::pq_rollback_witness::tests::guarded_charge_pending_revocation_survive_service_cold_restart",
    "store::pq_rollback_witness::tests::whole_node_old_sqlite_and_checkpoint_restore_is_rejected",
    "store::pq_rollback_witness::tests::witness_outage_latches_owner_without_refunding_or_charging_quota",
    "store::pq_rollback_witness::tests::lost_successful_cas_reply_never_revives_old_local_authority",
    "store::pq_rollback_witness::tests::local_commit_failure_after_external_cas_is_permanently_detectable",
    "store::pq_rollback_witness::tests::captured_signed_reply_cannot_answer_a_new_random_challenge",
    "store::pq_rollback_witness::tests::guarded_namespace_requires_explicit_guarded_open_and_existing_node",
    "store::pq_rollback_witness::tests::missing_external_state_is_not_enrolled_on_open_and_registration_is_exclusive",
    "store::pq_rollback_witness::tests::pending_permission_and_revocation_are_rechecked_under_fresh_predecessor",
    "store::pq_rollback_witness::tests::oversized_restored_fixed_blob_is_rejected_before_hashing_and_external_advance",
    "store::pq_rollback_witness::tests::binding_generation_policy_and_distinct_identity_are_mandatory",
    "store::pq_rollback_witness::tests::exact_cas_retry_is_idempotent_but_fork_skip_and_wrap_refuse",
    "store::pq_rollback_witness::tests::replacing_external_database_path_is_rejected_while_old_descriptor_is_locked",
    "store::pq_rollback_witness::tests::live_cancellation_after_current_prevents_pending_insert_and_owner_can_resume",
    "store::pq_rollback_witness::tests::expired_before_current_transport_does_not_poison_guarded_owner",
    "store::pq_rollback_witness::tests::uncertain_revocation_invalidates_epoch_of_already_admitted_work",
    "store::pq_rollback_witness::tests::authenticated_successful_cas_commits_before_late_live_cancellation",
    "store::pq_rollback_witness::tests::oversized_local_binding_and_checkpoint_are_rejected_before_blob_copy",
    "store::pq_rollback_witness::tests::non_system_trigger_with_sqlitex_prefix_cannot_hide_from_schema_check",
    "store::pq_rollback_witness::tests::oversized_external_binding_and_roots_are_rejected_before_blob_copy",
    "store::pq_rollback_witness::tests::authenticated_cas_receipt_after_original_deadline_still_aligns_local_commit",
    "store::pq_rollback_witness::tests::committed_expiry_retirement_publishes_epoch_even_when_live_callback_refuses",
    "store::pq_rollback_witness::tests::lost_retirement_cas_reply_preserves_terminal_zero_epoch",
    "store::pq_rollback_witness::tests::cached_permission_is_rechecked_after_actual_native_tcp_success",
    "store::pq_rollback_witness::tests::cold_reopen_rejects_oversized_metadata_and_accepts_exact_operator_repair",
    "store::pq_rollback_witness::combined_tests::guarded_npq6_submit_recovers_after_invalid_signature_and_independent_process_restart",
    "pq_rollback_witness::tests::malformed_local_checkpoints_never_enter_transport_or_poison_client",
    "pq_rollback_witness::tests::signed_current_cannot_regress_or_change_an_observed_generation",
    "pq_rollback_witness::tests::independent_clients_accept_other_writers_advances_and_cold_reopen",
    "pq_rollback_witness::tests::active_owner_requires_its_known_head_for_current_and_cas",
    "pq_rollback_witness::tests::failed_local_commit_fences_owner_until_explicit_reopen",
    "pq_rollback_witness::tests::durable_predecessor_shape_distinguishes_registration_from_advancement",
    "pq_rollback_witness::tests::cold_reopen_requires_exact_independently_retained_checkpoint",
    "pq_rollback_witness::tests::invalid_external_checkpoint_is_rejected_before_touching_recovery_storage",
    "store::pq_rollback_witness::tests::ordinary_admission_reuses_fresh_witness_guard_without_rechecking_unchanged_state",
    "store::pq_rollback_witness::tests::expired_admission_commits_retirement_then_obtains_a_new_witness_guard"
  ],
  "child_process_harnesses_not_counted": [
    "store::pq_rollback_witness::combined_tests::independent_witness_process_child"
  ],
  "whole_chain_quantum_security_qualified": false,
  "original_business_budgets_changed": false
}
